forecasts.notes: Title-only forecast. FDA guidance finalization often takes years; enforcement-related guidance can require additional stakeholder review. Timing and substantive predictions have substantial uncertainty.

Technical FDA guidance commonly preserves its central framework when finalized, but draft age and procedural maturity are unknown. Six-month finalization remains a minority outcome under general guidance base rates.
